_meta.purpose: External Support Index (ESI) construction spec — the indicator registry, normalization, and aggregation. Frozen BEFORE any test against outcomes (ESI_PREREGISTRATION.md). ESI is a CONTROL VARIABLE against the MI temporal-holdout results, testing whether external capital/institutional support explains the modern erosion of the institutional signal (ROBUSTNESS_RESULTS Findings 2-3, 5).
_meta.direction: ALL indicators normalized to [0,1] where HIGHER = MORE external support.
_meta.aggregation: Within each sub-dimension: mean of AVAILABLE normalized indicators (graceful degradation, no imputation). ESI = equal-weight mean of the 3 sub-dimension scores. Weights are NOT optimized (first pass; equal weights by design).
_meta.missing_data: Track-2 logic: use available indicators, document coverage per country-year; never impute. A sub-dimension with zero available indicators for a country-year is null; ESI = mean of the non-null sub-dimensions.

A_financial_life_support._doc: Active intervention — someone is subsidizing solvency right now.

imf_program_active.definition: binary: country under an active IMF arrangement (SBA, EFF, SAF/ESAF, PRGF/ECF, precautionary) in year T

imf_program_cumulative_20yr.definition: count of years under any IMF arrangement in the preceding 20 years (T-19..T), normalized by 20
imf_program_cumulative_20yr.rationale: captures chronic dependence vs one-off stabilization

concessional_debt_share.definition: external debt on concessional terms as a share of total external debt. Exact concessional-stock code resolved at fetch time (candidates: DT.DOD.DIMF.CD, concessional PPG series); documented in the fetch cache _meta.
concessional_debt_share.coverage_note: debtor-reporting (IDS) countries only — high-income issuers absent; treated as 0 concessional (they borrow commercially), documented.

debt_service_burden.definition: total external debt service as % of GNI. INVERSE/ambiguous indicator — high service with continued solvency implies someone keeps lending; high service with NO new lending implies approaching default.
debt_service_burden.normalization: percentile-rank across countries within year, then [0,1]; FLAGGED as ambiguous. Included in sub-A mean only in a sensitivity variant, NOT the primary ESI (see prereg 'debt_service handling'). Primary ESI excludes it to avoid sign ambiguity.

B_structural_dependency._doc: Chronic substitution — foreign capital/labour running a share of the economy in place of domestic P4 capacity.

fdi_net_inflows_pct_gdp.definition: FDI net inflows as % of GDP
fdi_net_inflows_pct_gdp.normalization: clamp negatives to 0; cap at ceiling then /ceiling. Ceiling = cross-country 90th percentile of the pooled distribution (documented at build), robust to Luxembourg/Ireland conduit outliers.

oda_pct_gni.source: World Bank WDI (already in MI pipeline)
oda_pct_gni.definition: net ODA received as % of GNI. In MI scoring this is INVERTED (aid = weakness); for ESI use UN-inverted (high ODA = high support).
oda_pct_gni.normalization: oda_pct / oda_full_dependence_pct (20, from LENS), clamp [0,1] — mirrors the MI normalizer's scale but NOT inverted

remittances_pct_gdp.definition: personal remittances received as % of GDP
remittances_pct_gdp.normalization: cap at ceiling then /ceiling; ceiling = cross-country 90th percentile (documented at build)

export_partner_hhi.source: UN COMTRADE via WITS / Harvard Atlas
export_partner_hhi.definition: Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of export destinations (high = dependent on one/two partners).
export_partner_hhi.phase1_status: DEFERRED — skip for Phase 1 if not programmatically available; flagged as future addition per task.

C_systemic_insurance._doc: Implicit guarantees / self-insurance — buffers that delay the consequences of structural misalignment. Mostly categorical/stable; manually coded once for all countries.

reserve_currency_status.definition: binary: issues a global reserve currency (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF; RMB from 2016 SDR inclusion). Eurozone members credited via EUR.

eu_eurozone_membership.definition: tiered: 0 none, 0.33 EU candidate/association agreement, 0.67 EU member, 1.0 Eurozone member
eu_eurozone_membership.time_varying: coded per year against accession/adoption dates

nato_alliance_membership.definition: tiered security insurance: 0 none, 0.5 formal defense partnership / major-non-NATO-ally, 1.0 NATO or equivalent mutual-defense treaty with a nuclear power
nato_alliance_membership.time_varying: coded per year against accession dates

swf_assets_pct_gdp.definition: sovereign wealth fund assets as % of GDP (self-insurance buffer)
swf_assets_pct_gdp.normalization: assets_pct_gdp / ceiling, clamp [0,1]; ceiling documented at build (Gulf outliers capped)
swf_assets_pct_gdp.coverage_note: SWF data barely exists pre-2000; use available, document coverage

reserves_months_imports.definition: foreign-exchange reserves in months of imports (basic self-insurance)
reserves_months_imports.normalization: cap at ceiling then /ceiling; ceiling = cross-country 90th percentile (documented at build)
